allowed_implementation_freedom: Internal language types, module boundaries, algorithms, and storage are unconstrained when every cited observable distinction is preserved.
Exact diagnostic wording and ordering are unconstrained unless a cited authority explicitly requires them.

authorities.clause: Admitted grammar / Literal characters and escaping

canonical_input_forms: Unicode scalar pattern and Unicode scalar input
non_normative_behaviors: Python object types, exception classes, module layout, and incidental algorithms are not semantic authority.
Rust crate, module, and internal type layout are not semantic authority.
required_state_distinctions: literal scalars match exactly
a proper substring does not match
matching compares exact Unicode scalar values
composed and decomposed spellings remain distinct
^ denotes exact input start
$ denotes exact input end, not before a final LF
escaped dot matches a literal dot
unescaped dot is rejected rather than treated as wildcard
a positive class admits listed members
a negated class rejects listed members and admits other scalars
inclusive ASCII ranges match exact code points
a first unescaped hyphen is literal
a final unescaped hyphen is literal
[a-b-c] is rejected
multiple successful alternatives select source order
an empty pattern full-matches the empty input
an empty group participates with an empty capture
an empty alternative is admitted
capture numbers follow opening-group source order
a named capture is also the same positional capture
duplicate named captures are rejected
a capture in an unselected alternative is absent
a participating empty capture is present and distinct from absence
greedy repetition backs down only as needed for full match
a repeated capture reports its last successful participation
an earlier nested capture remains when a later outer repetition omits it
bounded repetition of an empty-matching group is admitted
a 1500-count bounded nullable repetition is independent of Python recursion limits
unbounded repetition of an empty-matching expression is rejected
lookaround, backreference, inline flags, shorthand and native extensions are rejected
